articles.text: Edwards Lifesciences to Host Earnings Conference Call on July 23, 2026. IRVINE, Calif., July 16, 2026--Edwards Lifesciences (NYSE: EW) plans to announce its operating results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 after the market closes on Thursday July 23, and will host a conference call at 5:00 p.m. ET that day to discuss those results.

articles.text: Edwards Lifesciences served $10m penalty over JC Medical acquisition violations. The FTC secured the penalty after a court ruled that Edwards failed to comply with antitrust law requirements when it acquired JC Medical in 2024.
articles.headline: Edwards Lifesciences served $10m penalty over JC Medical acquisition violations
articles.summary: The FTC secured the penalty after a court ruled that Edwards failed to comply with antitrust law requirements when it acquired JC Medical in 2024.
